page_title: NAP 0-2 BOL | Napoli v Bologna 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
85' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
82' The substitution has been made. Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) has replaced Remo Freuler.
81' Substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) on for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
81' Francesco Calzona prepares a substitution. Mathias Olivera is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
81' Substitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) in, Frank Anguissa out.
80' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post.
78' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
75' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Today's match ends for Joshua Zirkzee who will be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
73' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replaces Kacper Urbanski.
72' Jens Cajuste will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
71' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) picks up a yellow card.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
68' The ball is laid off to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Federico Ravaglia to make a decent save.
66' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

66' This was a piece of cake for Alex Meret. Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
63' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
61' Substitution. Matteo Politano is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
57' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Here is a change. Dan Ndoye is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna).
56' It's time for a substitution. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) comes on in place of Jens Odgaard.
52' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' A cross into the box from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared.
47' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
46' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
41' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
40' CHANCE! Matteo Politano (Napoli) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
39' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
33' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is booked for saying more than Luca Pairetto was willing to tolerate.
32' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
30' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Luca Pairetto signals a foul.
27' A dangerous towering header by Mathias Olivera (Napoli) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
27' Napoli win a corner.
23' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
23' The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.

21' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Federico Ravaglia anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
20' Poor challenge! Remo Freuler (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. The referee makes the call - penalty to Napoli!
19' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' 0 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Calafiori gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Stefan Posch (Bologna) glances a header into the net. 0:2.
12' The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
12' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
9' 0 - 1 Dan Ndoye (Bologna) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
8' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
8' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
5' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Luca Pairetto is introduced as the referee for today's match.
